values.name: param()
values.prose: All three methods of setting link parameters share the same syntax for defining a parameter, using the param() function:

values.name: color
values.prose: Sets the initial value of the color property on the linked resource, and defaults to the value of the color property on the linking element.

values.name: accent-color
values.prose: Sets the initial value of the accent-color property on the linked resource, and defaults to the value of the accent-color property on the linking element.

values.name: <dashed-ident>
values.prose: Sets a custom environment variable of the given name on the linked resource, and defaults to the value of the custom property of the same name on the linking element.
